d:
Israil ke chunav men rikord voting ke bavjud kisi bhi gut ko spasht bahumat nahin mila. netanyahu ki likud parti abhi tak sabse bari parti hai lekin bahumat se kaphi dur hai. arab partiyon ka pradarshan bhi behtar raha. dharmik aur dharmanirpeksh samudayon ke bich tanav, gaza yuddh aur netanyahu ke virodhiyon ke bich matbhed naee sarkar ke gathan ko mushkil bana sakte hain. kya israil men gathbandhan ki rajniti in gahri dararon ko pat paegi?
